newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX heating oil up on late season demand.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX heating oil up on late season demand.

text.p: NYMEX heating oil futures were firm in early afternoon trading Tuesday as recent cold weather helped to reverse the usual seasonal price decline, traders said.

Crude futures were slightly higher, helped by unrest in one of Nigeria's oil-producing regions, but the sector was looking technically "toppy" unless there was news of a major supply disruption, taders said.
April heating oil was up 0.82 cents at 56.55 cents a gallon at 1315 EST, down from a high of 57.10 cents. May crude was up three cents at $21.10 a barrel.
